weekend_note: Dry and cooler through the weekend: highs near 72 on Friday and Saturday with lows around 62, then a bit warmer Sunday. Rain chances were not listed for most days, with 20% showing only for Monday Oct 19. Isaias recovery continues: ECUA lifted its boil-water notice Tuesday for most of mainland Escambia, but Pensacola Beach was still under one with a lift expected by Wednesday, so confirm beach events before driving out. No organizer has confirmed post-storm status for most events. Picks: Blue Angels practice today, Gallery Night and Beach-O-Ween on Oct 16, Ice Flyers opening night in the Bay Center on Oct 17 (indoors) and Barktoberfest on Oct 18.

news.title: FPL says more than 85% of power restored
news.summary: As of Tuesday morning FPL reported over 85 percent of affected customers back on, with Escambia and Santa Rosa, the hardest hit, expected to be essentially done by the end of Tuesday. Damaged homes may need an electrician before they can safely take power.

news.title: ECUA lifts boil-water notice for most of mainland Escambia
news.summary: The notice was lifted Tuesday morning for most of the mainland, including Perdido Key. Pensacola Beach remained under it, with a lift expected by Wednesday, and a list of specific streets still needs to boil water until ECUA clears them.

news.title: Santa Rosa County schools to stay closed until Monday
news.summary: The Santa Rosa school board voted to keep schools closed until next Monday. The superintendent cited repairs, power and a shortage of bus drivers. Escambia reopening dates were not found in this run.

news.title: Several Santa Rosa schools too damaged to reopen
news.summary: Per the headline, about half a dozen Santa Rosa County schools sustained too much damage to reopen after the storm. Details were not read beyond the headline.

news.title: City of Pensacola recovery: meal sites, airport and debris rules
news.summary: The Salvation Army is serving free meals at four sites, including Pensacola Library and Carver Park in Cantonment. The airport is open with schedules recovering slowly, and the city says a contractor handles storm debris, which should be separated by type and not bagged.

news.title: Bay Center's Southern Tip Off basketball game canceled
news.summary: The Mississippi State vs Florida State game at the Pensacola Bay Center was canceled because of Isaias. Organizers are looking at rescheduling, and Ticketmaster buyers are being refunded automatically.

news.title: Festa Italiana moves to mid-November
news.summary: The downtown festival is now set for Nov 13 and 14 from 11 AM to 6 PM at Fountain Park, with free admission.

coverage_note: Written overnight Wednesday Oct 14. Fresh details came only from WEAR articles dated Oct 11 to 13; Local Pulse, NWS, NorthEscambia.com, Must Do Pensacola, the Saenger and Ice Flyers sites could not be opened, so event listings are carried over from earlier checks with no post-storm confirmation. The forecast is WeatherBug's Pensacola Beach 10-day outlook, which listed rain chances only for Oct 19 (20%); other days are shown as 0 but are really unlisted, and its temperatures differ from the earlier NWS numbers. No day-8 beyond Oct 21 shown. Gonzalez and north Escambia coverage remains thin (library programs only), no Escambia school reopening date was found, and no new restaurant openings or closings were confirmed; Pelican Bar and Grill, Casa Luvia and Launch stay unconfirmed. Visit Pensacola lists Taste of the Beach on earlier dates than Must Do Pensacola does, so check before going.
